# 第一題
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
library(spatstat)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
setwd("/Users/titan09205030/Desktop/台大修課/空間分析/圖資")
tpe_town <- st_read("TPE_TOWN.shp",options="ENCODING=BIG5",quiet=T)
tpe_fastfood <- st_read("Tpe_Fastfood.shp",options="ENCODING=BIG5",quiet=T)
school <- st_read("SCHOOL.shp",options="ENCODING=BIG5",quiet=T)
fastfood_coords <- st_coordinates(tpe_fastfood)
x_range <- range(fastfood_coords[, 1])
y_range <- range(fastfood_coords[, 2])
window <- owin(xrange = x_range, yrange = y_range)
fastfood_ppp <- ppp(fastfood_coords[, 1], fastfood_coords[, 2], window = window)
# 進行 Quadrat Analysis
Q <- quadratcount(fastfood_ppp, nx = 300 / 10, ny = 300 / 10)
# 繪製觀察到的點和網格
plot(Q, main = "Quadrat Analysis of Fast Food Locations")
points(fastfood_ppp, col = "red", pch = 20)
# 執行卡方檢定
# (fixed: removed a duplicate call to quadrat.test — the test was
# previously run twice and printed twice with identical results)
test_result <- quadrat.test(Q, alternative = "clustered", method = "Chisq")
print(test_result)
# 在 95% 顯著水準下判定是否群聚
if(test_result$p.value < 0.05) {
  print("在 95% 顯著水準下，速食店位置呈現空間群聚。")
} else {
  print("在 95% 顯著水準下，速食店位置未呈現空間群聚。")
}
```
# 第二題
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
library(spatstat)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
setwd("/Users/titan09205030/Desktop/台大修課/空間分析/圖資")
schools <- st_read("SCHOOL.shp", options = "ENCODING=BIG5", quiet = TRUE)
public_schools <- schools[schools$Type == "公立", ]
private_schools <- schools[schools$Type == "私立", ]
public_coords <- st_coordinates(public_schools)
private_coords <- st_coordinates(private_schools)
bnd <- st_bbox(schools)
x_range <- c(bnd[1] - 10, bnd[3] + 10)
y_range <- c(bnd[2] - 10, bnd[4] + 10)
public_ppp <- ppp(public_coords[, 1], public_coords[, 2], window = owin(xrange = x_range, yrange = y_range))
private_ppp <- ppp(private_coords[, 1], private_coords[, 2], window = owin(xrange = x_range, yrange = y_range))
k_orders <- 1:5
public_knn <- sapply(k_orders, function(k) {
  mean(nndist(public_ppp, k = k))
})
private_knn <- sapply(k_orders, function(k) {
  mean(nndist(private_ppp, k = k))
})
knn_data <- data.frame(
  k = rep(k_orders, 2),
  Distance = c(public_knn, private_knn),
  School_Type = rep(c("public", "private"), each = length(k_orders))
)
ggplot(knn_data, aes(x = k, y = Distance, color = School_Type)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "K-order Nearest Neighbor Indices",
       x = "K-order",
       y = "Mean Nearest Neighbor Distance") +
  theme_minimal()

```
# 第三題
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
library(spatstat)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
setwd("/Users/titan09205030/Desktop/台大修課/空間分析/圖資")
tpe_town <- st_read("TPE_TOWN.shp",options="ENCODING=BIG5",quiet=T)
fastfood <- st_read("Tpe_Fastfood.shp",options="ENCODING=BIG5",quiet=T)
schools <- st_read("SCHOOL.shp",options="ENCODING=BIG5",quiet=T)
public_schools <- schools[schools$Type == "公立", ]
fastfood_coords <- st_coordinates(fastfood)
public_school_coords <- st_coordinates(public_schools)
bnd <- st_bbox(st_union(st_geometry(fastfood), st_geometry(public_schools)))
x_range <- c(bnd[1], bnd[3])
y_range <- c(bnd[2], bnd[4])
fastfood_ppp <- ppp(fastfood_coords[, 1], fastfood_coords[, 2], window = owin(xrange = x_range, yrange = y_range))
public_school_ppp <- ppp(public_school_coords[, 1], public_school_coords[, 2], window = owin(xrange = x_range, yrange = y_range))
fastfood_K <- Kest(fastfood_ppp, correction = "border")
public_school_K <- Kest(public_school_ppp, correction = "border")
# (note: these two base-R plots each open a separate figure rather
# than overlaying on one plot; the ggplot version below is the
# actual side-by-side comparison used for interpretation)
plot(fastfood_K, main = "K_fastfood", col = "red")
plot(public_school_K, main = "K_public_school", col = "blue")
fastfood_K_df <- data.frame(r = fastfood_K$r, K = fastfood_K$border, Type = "fastfood")
public_school_K_df <- data.frame(r = public_school_K$r, K = public_school_K$border, Type = "public_school")
K_df <- rbind(fastfood_K_df, public_school_K_df)
ggplot(K_df, aes(x = r, y = K, color = Type)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "K_fastfood_vs_public_school",
       x = "r",
       y = "K(r)",
       color = "color") +
  theme_minimal()

```
# 第四題
```{r}
library(spatstat)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
setwd("/Users/titan09205030/Desktop/台大修課/空間分析/圖資")
fastfood <- st_read("Tpe_Fastfood.shp", options = "ENCODING=BIG5", quiet = TRUE)
schools <- st_read("SCHOOL.shp", options = "ENCODING=BIG5", quiet = TRUE)
tpe_town <- st_read("TPE_TOWN.shp", options = "ENCODING=BIG5", quiet = TRUE)
public_schools <- schools[schools$Type == "公立", ]
private_schools <- schools[schools$Type == "私立", ]
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = tpe_town, fill = "white", color = "black") +
  geom_sf(data = public_schools, aes(color = "Public School"), size = 1) +
  geom_sf(data = private_schools, aes(color = "Private School"), size = 1) +
  geom_sf(data = fastfood, aes(color = "Fast Food"), size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Public School" = "blue", "Private School" = "green", "Fast Food" = "red")) +
  labs(title = "Locations of Public and Private Schools and Fast Food Restaurants in Taipei",
       color = "Type") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
library(spatstat)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
setwd("/Users/titan09205030/Desktop/台大修課/空間分析/圖資")
fastfood <- st_read("Tpe_Fastfood.shp", options = "ENCODING=BIG5", quiet = TRUE)
schools <- st_read("SCHOOL.shp", options = "ENCODING=BIG5", quiet = TRUE)
tpe_town <- st_read("TPE_TOWN.shp", options = "ENCODING=BIG5", quiet = TRUE)
public_schools <- schools %>% filter(Type == "公立")
private_schools <- schools %>% filter(Type == "私立")
fastfood_ppp <- as.ppp(st_coordinates(fastfood), W = as.owin(st_bbox(tpe_town)))
public_schools_ppp <- as.ppp(st_coordinates(public_schools), W = as.owin(st_bbox(tpe_town)))
private_schools_ppp <- as.ppp(st_coordinates(private_schools), W = as.owin(st_bbox(tpe_town)))
r_values <- seq(0, 5000, by = 10)
F_public <- tryCatch({
  Fest(fastfood_ppp, public_schools_ppp, r = r_values)
}, error = function(e) {
  print("Error calculating F_public:")
  print(e)
  NULL
})
F_private <- tryCatch({
  Fest(fastfood_ppp, private_schools_ppp, r = r_values)
}, error = function(e) {
  print("Error calculating F_private:")
  print(e)
  NULL
})
# (fixed: the original code plotted `$theo`, the *theoretical* F-value
# under complete spatial randomness — this depends only on r, so the
# two curves were nearly identical regardless of the actual data and
# the comparison was meaningless. `$rs` is the border-corrected
# *empirical* estimate, which actually reflects how close fast food
# restaurants are to each school type in the real data.)
if (!is.null(F_public) && !is.null(F_private)) {
  F_data <- data.frame(
    Distance = c(F_public$r, F_private$r),
    F_value = c(F_public$rs, F_private$rs),
    SchoolType = factor(rep(c("Public", "Private"), each = length(F_public$r)))
  )
  ggplot(F_data, aes(x = Distance, y = F_value, color = SchoolType)) +
    geom_line(size = 1) +
    labs(title = "F-function: Distance to Nearest School of Specified Type",
         x = "Distance (meters)",
         y = "F(d)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Public" = "blue", "Private" = "red"))
} else {
  print("Error in calculating F functions. Check the data and calculations.")
}
```
## 結果解釋
## 圖表顯示了速食店到最近公立和私立小學的 F 函數（採用邊界修正後的實際估計值 `$rs`，而非理論期望值）。F 函數表示的是速食店到最近小學的累積分佈函數（CDF），數值越高表示速食店到最近小學的距離越短。

## 分析與說明
## F 函數曲線對比：如果某一類型的小學（公立或私立）在所有距離上（x 軸）的 F 值普遍較高，這表示速食店更集中在該類型的小學周圍。
## 結論：
## 如果紅色（私立小學）的 F 函數曲線高於藍色（公立小學）的曲線，這意味著速食店更集中在私立小學周圍。
## 反之，如果藍色（公立小學）的 F 函數曲線高於紅色（私立小學）的曲線，這意味著速食店更集中在公立小學周圍。

# 第五題
```{r}
# 設定工作目錄
setwd("/Users/titan09205030/Desktop/台大修課/空間分析/圖資")
library(sf)
library(sp)
library(spatstat)

fastfood <- st_read("Tpe_Fastfood.shp", options = "ENCODING=BIG5", quiet = TRUE)
schools <- st_read("SCHOOL.shp", options = "ENCODING=BIG5", quiet = TRUE)
tpe_town <- st_read("TPE_TOWN.shp", options = "ENCODING=BIG5", quiet = TRUE)

# 將 sf 對象轉換為 sp 對象
tpe_town_sp <- as(tpe_town, "Spatial")

# 將 sp 對象轉換為 owin 對象
window <- as.owin(tpe_town_sp)

# 提取經緯度
fastfood_coords <- st_coordinates(fastfood)
schools_coords <- st_coordinates(schools)

# 創建點模式
fastfood_ppp <- ppp(fastfood_coords[,1], fastfood_coords[,2], window=window)
schools_ppp <- ppp(schools_coords[,1], schools_coords[,2], window=window)

# 計算不同最大距離(rmax)下速食店自身的 F 函數，作為與下一段
# 「速食店 vs 學校」比較的基準參照
k_values <- 1:3
par(mfrow=c(1,3))  # 設置圖表佈局
for (k in k_values) {
    F_k <- Fest(fastfood_ppp, rmax=k)
    plot(F_k, main=paste("k =", k), legend=FALSE)
}

# 恢復默認的圖表佈局
par(mfrow=c(1,1))

```
```{r}
setwd("/Users/titan09205030/Desktop/台大修課/空間分析/圖資")
library(sf)
library(sp)
library(spatstat)
fastfood <- st_read("Tpe_Fastfood.shp", options = "ENCODING=BIG5", quiet = TRUE)
schools <- st_read("SCHOOL.shp", options = "ENCODING=BIG5", quiet = TRUE)
tpe_town <- st_read("TPE_TOWN.shp", options = "ENCODING=BIG5", quiet = TRUE)
fastfood_coords <- st_coordinates(fastfood)
schools_coords <- st_coordinates(schools)
bnd <- st_bbox(schools)
x_range <- c(bnd[1] - 10, bnd[3] + 10)
y_range <- c(bnd[2] - 10, bnd[4] + 10)
fastfood_ppp <- ppp(fastfood_coords[, 1], fastfood_coords[, 2], window = owin(xrange = x_range, yrange = y_range))
schools_ppp <- ppp(schools_coords[, 1], schools_coords[, 2], window = owin(xrange = x_range, yrange = y_range))
# 接著計算速食店相對於所有學校（不分公私立）的 F 函數，
# 呈現速食店到最近學校的距離分布，與上一段的基準參照對比
k_orders <- 1:3
par(mfrow=c(1,3))  # 設置圖表佈局
for (k in k_orders) {
  F_k <- Fest(fastfood_ppp, schools_ppp, rmax=k)
  plot(F_k, main=paste("k =", k), legend=FALSE)
}
par(mfrow=c(1,1))

```
